# fuel-cells

Patch rows on this catalog use `"catalog": "fuel-cells"` and a `key` from the records below. The catalog is closed: a mod changes values with patch rows (see [Patch operations](patch-ops.md)) and cannot add records.

## Records

`standard`, `deuterium`, `iridium`, `tessarite`, `thorium`

## Copy this row

A row that changes nothing: `value` and `expect` both hold the base value. Change `value` to the number you want.

```json
{
  "op": "set",
  "catalog": "fuel-cells",
  "key": "standard",
  "path": "pc",
  "value": 4,
  "expect": {"pc":4}
}
```
